description: This file is a shell script that defines and runs a series of tests for a git and CVS integration project, specifically testing 'git-cvsserver' and refspec handling. It sets up repositories, performs checkouts, commits, diffs, and integrations to ensure that the git-cvsserver functions correctly across various scenarios.

methods.name: check_start_tree
methods.description: Logs the start of a tree check with the given label.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Verifies a specific file at a particular version matches expected content from a sandbox.

methods.name: check_end_tree
methods.description: Checks that the current directory matches the expected file list for a tree.

methods.name: check_end_full_tree
methods.description: Checks that the directory tree and git refs match the expected file list and specified branch/tag.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Creates a sandbox, applies a diff, and checks if the diff results match expectations.
